_comment: Add a _ before an option name to comment it out and it wont be added to the apworld
Using 'goal' as the name of an option let you override some of the generated goal parameters
description: How to End your Randomized playthrough.
Currently this is simply achieved by beating a specific floor number
or by beating Dyle's floor

filler_traps._comment: Using values here let you set a 'recommended' filler_trap percentage or even a default percentage

description: This is the final floor number to beat to win the game (if Final Floor is the goal)
You can adjust this value to a number you prefer.
If Dyle floor is the goal, this value will only be ignored unless set above 43.
(This is because Dyle Floor is forced to be encountered at floor 43. 45 if there is an event.
Setting this value to 0 will go back to the default.
DEFAULT: 20
Here you can specify how many toons you must reach the goal with in order to win.
Because there are 40 toons in the game, you can set this value to any number between 1 and 40.
DEFAULT: 1
Here you can specify which toons you must win the game with. or to be random
Leave blank if any toons can be used to reach the goal.
If the number_Of_Toons_To_Reach_Goal is less than the toons specified here, this will be prioritised.
Example: ["Astro", "Razzle&Dazzle", "Pebble"]
Specify what toon you would like to start with.
A later version might allow for better customising.
Here you can specify which toons/trinkets you own or don't own.
You only need to fill out excluding or including options.
Some players may be missing more toons/trinkets than others, so enter what is easier.
Leave blank if any toons can be used to reach the goal.
Example toons: ["Astro", "Razzle&Dazzle", "Pebble"]
Example trinkets: ["Star_Pillow", "Ghost_Snakes_In_A_Can", "Brick"]
Here you can select what event (if any) is occurring.
This will include the relevant twisteds into logic.
This is a Toggle
A simple boolean, aka True or False set the initial value with "default"
This is a Choice
Let the user pick from a list of values
allow_custom_value let a player define their own text value
Currently the only use for Choice in Manual outside of hooks is the goal
This is a Range
Allow the player to specify a value between 'start' and 'end'
if you include a "values" you can define the label for certain values
Currently the only use for Range in Manual outside of hooks is 'filler_trap'
